site_name: Telehouse New York Chelsea, 85 10th Ave, New York, NY
year_evidence_quote: 2011: Telehouse opens Chelsea facility in New York, a second facility in Hong Kong and expands in Istanbul.
year_site_match: Telehouse's own history page names the "Chelsea facility in New York"; Telehouse's New York data centers page (opened) says "Our New York colocation facility is located in Manhattan's Chelsea at 85 10th Avenue" with 60,000 sq ft, matching this address. verification: Year 2011 confirmed, but on a stronger source than the researcher's cited JSA post. The operator's history page (undated, so page_date is null) states outright that Telehouse opened the Chelsea facility in 2011. Supporting pages opened: the Telehouse release dated January 11, 2011 says the facility is "opening on January 24, 2011" (forward-looking on its own); Data Center Knowledge, byline January 11, 2011, says it "is scheduled to open its doors on Jan. 24"; the JSA post headlined "TELEHOUSE America Opens its Doors at 85 10th Avenue" announces a grand opening event "on Thursday, February 3" but carries no year on the page (2011 appears only in its image-link paths), so it is not the cited evidence. Wikipedia also lists 2011 but unsourced. Caveat: the Jan 2011 coverage says Telehouse "acquired" 60,000 sq ft of existing data center space in the building, so 2011 is the year Telehouse's facility opened, not necessarily the first year any data center operated at 85 10th Avenue; no page I opened dates an earlier operator's use.
